messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: stat_vline bug?
parts:
Dear all,

stat_vline used to work for me, but I now get an error:

qplot(1, 1) + stat_vline(xintercept=1)
Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom =
geom, :
argument "intercept" is missing, with no default

qplot(1, 1) + stat_vline(intercept=1)
Error in get("calculate", env = ., inherits = TRUE)(., ...) :
stat_vline now uses xintercept instead of intercept

Is this normal?

Best regards,

baptiste

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: stat_vline bug?
parts:
Hi Baptiste,

It's probably better to use geom_vline() - I still haven't figured out
exactly how these geoms should work yet, and geom_vline and geom_hline
are more likely to work in general.

Hadley
